errors.leadCannotBeDeleted: The lead agent can't be deleted; make another agent the lead first
errors.rootCannotMove: The organization root can't be moved
errors.unitCycle: A unit can't be moved into its own sub-unit
errors.rootCannotDelete: The organization root can't be deleted
errors.projectNotFoundDeleted: Project not found; it may have been deleted
errors.onlyProject: This is the only project; create another project before deleting it (or remove its folder and rename it)
errors.invalidDraft: The draft could not be saved (unknown channel or too long).
errors.stopNotConfirmed: {{key}} could not be confirmed as stopped, so it was not moved. Stop it again, then move it.
errors.noSecureStorage: This computer has no secure key storage (OS keychain), so Agentbits does not store passwords, keys or tokens. On Linux install and unlock a keyring (GNOME Keyring / KWallet).
errors.untrustedSender: This request did not come from the Agentbits window and was refused
errors.endpointInvalid: The endpoint address is not valid (an http(s) URL without user, query or fragment).
errors.endpointInsecure: An API key may only be sent over HTTPS, or over http to this computer (localhost / 127.0.0.1).

folders.appFolder: This folder is the Agentbits application itself. It can't be chosen as a project folder, so agents don't change the app's code.
folders.inUse: This folder is already used by the project “{{name}}”
folders.tooBroad: This folder is too broad for agents (a drive root, your home folder or a folder that holds Agentbits' data). Pick the project's own folder.

steering.resume: The current step is interrupted; the same Claude Code conversation continues with the instruction (--resume).
steering.simulated: Demo provider: the instruction is handled in a simulation.
steering.restart: This provider has no live session: the current step is interrupted and restarts with the partial output + the instruction.

usageReporting.full: Actual values reported by the provider
usageReporting.partial: The provider only reports the total (in the input column)

db.none: Can't see or use the connection
db.read: Only SELECT / SHOW / EXPLAIN; runs in a read-only transaction that is rolled back
db.admin: Everything: DDL (CREATE / ALTER / DROP), GRANT, multiple statements

ssh.none: Can't see or use the server
ssh.read: Only commands in the read list
ssh.write: Commands in the read + write lists
ssh.execute: Commands in the read + write + execute lists
ssh.admin: Any command (still limited by the server user's own permissions)

ssh.notAllowed: “{{segment}}” is not in the allowed command lists
ssh.unsafeRead: “{{segment}}” can run other programs or change files, so it never counts as a read

errors.kindLocked: The connection type can't be changed later; create a new connection
errors.approvalNotFound: Approval request not found (it may have expired)
errors.schemaDbOnly: Only database connections have a schema
errors.hostKeyChanged: The server key has changed (expected {{expected}}, got {{got}}). If the server really changed, reset the key in the connection settings.
errors.hostKeyNotPinned: The server key isn't verified yet ({{got}}). Open the connection in Organization → Connections and click "Test" to check and pin it.
errors.productionNeedsTls: A Production database must not cross the network unencrypted. Turn on "SSL / TLS", connect through SSH, or — if the server has no TLS and is on your company network — accept an unencrypted connection.
errors.serverNoTls: This server doesn't support encrypted connections. Turn off SSL / TLS and connect through SSH, or — on your private network — accept an unencrypted connection.
errors.tunnelMissing: The SSH connection chosen for the tunnel no longer exists. Pick another one or connect directly.
errors.tunnelRefused: The SSH server refused to forward the connection ({{message}}). Its sshd may have AllowTcpForwarding turned off.
errors.tunnelInUse: Used as the SSH tunnel of: {{names}}. Change those connections first.
errors.tooManyRows: The query returned more than {{max}} rows and was stopped; add a LIMIT / WHERE
errors.noAnswer: The server did not answer within {{seconds}} seconds
errors.cancelled: Cancelled: the run was stopped, the connection was closed

denied.noAccess: This connection doesn't exist or you have no access to it
denied.statementNeeds: This statement needs “{{needs}}” access; yours is “{{have}}”
denied.commandNeeds: This command needs “{{needs}}” access; yours is “{{have}}”
denied.notApproved: The user did not approve the Production operation (or it timed out)
denied.changedWhileWaiting: Access to this connection changed while the request was waiting for approval; it was not run
denied.readOnlyLoginRequired: Agents can only read through a read-only database user, and this connection has none. Ask the user to add one under Connections → this connection → Read-only user.
denied.chatReadOnly: In chat, agents can only read from connections (schema, SELECT). Changing data, DDL and SSH commands run in a task.
denied.exportReadOnly: db_export only runs reads (one SELECT). To change data use db_query in a task.

toast.approvalRequested: {{agent}} is asking for approval for an operation on {{name}} (Production)

test.okReadOnly: Connection successful · read-only user verified too

errors.attachmentOtherProject: An attachment belongs to another project
errors.originalGone: The file's original no longer exists (deleted or moved)
errors.originalGoneShort: The file's original no longer exists
errors.unsafeOpen: .{{ext}} files aren't opened directly for security reasons; download them with “Save as”
errors.revealWorkspaceOnly: Only files in the project folder can be shown
errors.quota: The file store is full ({{used}} MB of {{quota}} MB). Delete files you no longer need or raise the limit in Settings → Security and limits.

files.largeNotExtracted: Large file; content not extracted (open it from the folder)

audit.recordDeleted: Record deleted (the file in the project folder was not touched)

extract.zipBomb: The archive exceeds the allowed size when unpacked (possibly a zip bomb); not processed
extract.pdfPassword: The PDF is password-protected; it couldn't be opened
extract.pdfPagesLimited: The PDF has {{total}} pages; only the first {{n}} were read
extract.textLimitPage: Text limit reached; nothing after page {{n}} was read

extract.docxInvalid: Not a valid Word (.docx) document (no word/document.xml)
extract.textLimitDoc: Text limit reached; the rest of the document was not read
extract.footnotes: Footnotes and endnotes were not included
extract.xlsxInvalid: Not a valid Excel (.xlsx) file (no xl/workbook.xml)
extract.sheetRowLimit: Row limit reached in sheet “{{name}}”; nothing after row {{row}} was read
extract.csvBadRows: Format errors in {{n}} rows (quotes / column count)
extract.image: Image: no text is extracted (no OCR); it is given as an image to models that support images
extract.imageMismatch: The extension says image, but the content is not a recognized image format
extract.unsupported: Content can't be extracted from the “.{{ext}}” format. Supported: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, TXT/code, Markdown, JSON, images.
extract.noText: No readable text was found in the file
extract.legacyEncrypted: The file is password-protected; it can't be read
extract.xlsOld: Excel 5.0/95 or older workbooks are not supported; save it as .xlsx or .xls (97–2003)
extract.legacyInvalid: Could not read this Office 97–2003 file ({{message}})
extract.imageOcr: Image; its text was recognised with OCR (may contain mistakes)
extract.pdfOcr_one: {{n}} scanned page was read with OCR (may contain mistakes)
extract.pdfOcr_other: {{n}} scanned pages were read with OCR (may contain mistakes)
extract.ocrPartial: Not every scanned page could be read with OCR (page or time limit)

dbStart.title: Agentbits can't open your data

message.tooNew: Your data was saved by a newer version of Agentbits.
message.backup: Agentbits couldn't back up your data before upgrading it.
message.migrate: Upgrading your data to this version failed.

dbStart.tooNew: The data is at schema version {{found}}; this version knows up to {{latest}}. Nothing was changed.
dbStart.backup: Without that backup the upgrade didn't run: your data is unchanged (schema version {{found}}).
dbStart.migrate: Your data was not reset or emptied, and it is still at schema version {{found}}: the upgrade to {{latest}} was rolled back as a whole.
dbStart.backupAt: Backup taken just before the upgrade: {{path}}

recover.tooNew: Install the newer version of Agentbits again (or the version that saved this data).
recover.backup: Make room on the disk or check the data folder's permissions, then start Agentbits again.
recover.migrate: Keep the backup. To go back: close Agentbits, install the version you used before, then replace agentbits.db in the data folder with the backup file (rename it to agentbits.db). Please report the problem with the error below.
recover.open: Check that the data folder is reachable and no other program holds agentbits.db, then start Agentbits again.
